mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT sido_name FROM region_code WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND is_abolished = 'N' ORDER BY sido_name
SELECT DISTINCT sigungu_name, sigungu_code FROM region_code WHERE sido_name = #{sidoName} AND del_yn = 'N' AND is_abolished = 'N' ORDER BY sigungu_name
SELECT region_code, umd_name FROM region_code WHERE sigungu_code = #{sigunguCode} AND del_yn = 'N' AND is_abolished = 'N' ORDER BY umd_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rent_goal ( user_id, title, selection_mode, school_id, commute_radius_km, monthly_budget, residence_preset, residence_months, status, created_date, created_nm, del_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{selectionMode}, #{schoolId}, #{commuteRadiusKm}, #{monthlyBudget}, #{residencePreset}, #{residenceMonths}, #{status}, NOW(), #{createdNm}, 'N' )

INSERT INTO rent_goal_region (goal_id, region_code, created_date, created_nm, del_yn) VALUES
(#{region.goalId}, #{region.regionCode}, NOW(), #{region.createdNm}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT school_id, school_name, address, sigungu_code, region_code, latitude, longitude FROM school WHERE school_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY school_name LIMIT 20

SELECT goal_id, user_id, title, selection_mode, school_id, commute_radius_km, monthly_budget, residence_preset, residence_months, status, confirmed_listing_id, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM rent_goal WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND del_yn = 'N'
SELECT region_code FROM rent_goal_region WHERE goal_id = #{goalId} AND del_yn = 'N'

SELECT goal_id, user_id, title, selection_mode, school_id, commute_radius_km, monthly_budget, residence_preset, residence_months, status, created_date, created_nm, modified_date, modified_nm, del_yn FROM rent_goal WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DRAFT' AND del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY goal_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT sigungu_code FROM region_code WHERE sigungu_code IS NOT NULL AND del_yn = 'N' AND is_abolished = 'N' ORDER BY sigungu_code
SELECT sido_name FROM region_code WHERE sigungu_code = #{sigunguCode} AND del_yn = 'N' LIMIT 1
